searchText: Not sure where to post this. So many channels! I couldn't find an Infura community, and this seemed like as good a place as any. I've been playing with both Infura and Alchemy today, and I prefer the Infura pricing model. But for some reason, while I can do both http and websocket with Alchemy, Infura websockets never connect for me. Anyone have this issue? I've found some posts with my error response from 2018, but nothing relevant recently. I feel I'm missing some simple step. > Error: connection not open on send() I've tried adding reconnects which doesn't help, and the primary issue appears to be that people get disconnected if they don't ping the socket periodically. But this is an error I get immediately. Yo if you're thinking about scamming me in DMs just chill. I'm not an idiot. i think i got what I wanted from alchemy webhooks. but any input would still be appreciated 🙂 Just realised this channel exists 😃 Infura has a forum and they have been very helpful whenever I asked something there. https://community.infura.io/ Hi! Any kind souls feel like donating some spare Ropsten ETH? I'm going a workshop with some people and need a bit more than faucets are giving me: 0x556E1fE6491036be98023B714390f1d4940Aaf45 sent 4 to you just now Thanks <@456226577798135808> !
